title: Agent lifecycle registry event (v1)
description: A single record of the append-only agent lifecycle event log (registry/events, issue #10), serialized as one JSON object per line in a JSON Lines log file. Every record carries a monotonic sequence number and a sha256 hash over its canonical content linked to the previous record's hash, so editing, deleting or reordering any past record is detected. The event-kind enum is closed; the status vocabulary is documented in registry/events/README.md.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number; records must be 1, 2, 3, ... with no gaps or duplicates.

ts.description: Event timestamp in RFC 3339 UTC, e.g. 2026-09-08T12:00:00Z.

event.description: Registry lifecycle / audit event kind. register/activate/pause/retire = agent lifecycle transitions; route = a task-route was set; session = identity credentials were issued.

status.description: Outcome/state the event records. Conventional values per kind - register: registered; activate: active; pause: paused; retire: retired; route: set; session: issued.

tenantId.description: The tenant (agent org) the event concerns. Registry events are always tenant-scoped; there is no global record.

agentId.description: Agent id the event concerns; null for a route event (which names multiple agents in its detail).

actor.description: Optional principal that caused the event (operator or parent agent id).

detail.description: Optional per-kind payload (e.g. taskType and agentIds for a route event).

prevHash.description: sha256 hash of the previous record (the fixed genesis hash for seq 1). Links the chain.

hash.description: sha256 over the record's canonical JSON excluding this hash field. Any content change breaks verification.
